FORM GST ASMT-10 DISCREPANCY INTIMATION
Notice Ref: ASMT10/DL/2023/1515 Dated 30-11-2023
GSTIN: 07AAABB1234A1Z1 M/s Capital Logistics & Trading
FY: 2022-23

1. Discrepancy based on E-Way Bill portal data: E-Way Bills generated by taxpayer reflect goods movement value of Rs. 85,00,000/-, whereas GSTR-3B taxable turnover reported is Rs. 65,00,000/-.
2. Discrepancy of Rs. 20,00,000/- is alleged as unrecorded outward sales supply.
